mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 800K units, indicating robust demand, boosts consumer confidence, leading to increased spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of instances when HOUST > 800K, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 0.5% signals accommodative monetary policy, reducing borrowing costs and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, always-on.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns when FEDFUNDS < 0.5% are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment (UNRATE) drops below 7% and payroll employment (PAYEMS) grows by > 200K in a month, the joint signal indicates a strong labor market, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 40% of instances when both conditions are met, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 1.5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) growth above 2% YoY, signaling increased economic activity, leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, but only during monetary tightening cycles.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 55% of instances when INDPRO growth > 2% YoY during tightening cycles, or Rank IC < 0.025 over any 2.5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Real GDP (GDPC1) growth exceeding 3% QoQ, indicating strong aggregate demand, always-on drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.035 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns when GDPC1 growth > 3% QoQ are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by > 50bps in a month, signaling a pivot towards accommodative policy, leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 45% of instances when FEDFUNDS decreases > 50bps, or Rank IC < 0.015 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 6% and payroll employment (PAYEMS) grows by > 150K in a month, but housing starts (HOUST) are below 700K, the mixed labor and demand signal leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE < 6% and PAYEMS growth > 150K and HOUST < 700K
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 50% of instances when all conditions are met, or Rank IC < 0.005 over any 1.5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) growth below -1% YoY, signaling economic contraction, always-on leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns when INDPRO growth < -1% YoY are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).
